name: OCRFlux-bench-cross
description:
OCRFlux-bench-cross
	

PDF documents are typically paginated, which often results in tables or paragraphs being split across consecutive pages. Accurately detecting and merging such cross-page structures is crucial to avoid generating incomplete or fragmented content. 
The detection task can be formulated as follows: given the Markdowns of two consecutive pages—each structured as a list of Markdown elements (e.g., paragraphs and tables)—the goal is to identify the indexes of elements… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ChatDOC/OCRFlux-bench-cross.
evaluation_method: F1 / precision & recall on detected cross-page merges (matching predicted element indices to ground truth)
general_score_metric: F1 score (matching predicted cross-page element pairs/indices)
reputation: Relatively new dataset on Hugging Face for document-structure and OCR post-processing tasks with limited but growing use in document understanding research.
